fusions.name: Rolling Maul
fusions.desc: Clamps the target and rolls, dealing 16 damage, stunning it for 1.2 seconds and leaving it 20% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Bank Breaker
fusions.desc: Slams your tail down, dealing 30 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. The blow ignores armour.

fusions.name: Dead Weight
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 35% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Heavy Feeder
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, your physical damage rises by 30% for 8 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
